summary: P1 1.5 Pass A1 -- adds signed per-attempt Remote DJ correlation, generation-binds asynchronous signaling/GStreamer callbacks, and preserves bounded browser/server milestone evidence as independent timing domains. Also makes the existing server STUN setting authoritative for the browser, hardens adjacent WebRTC/GStreamer construction failures to roll back through the safe idle lifecycle, and explicitly proves the libnice nicesrc/nicesink runtime elements in deployment preflight.
